name: BuildErrors
description: Report that the specification cannot be translated into correct code. This ends the build — no further edits may be made. Report ALL build errors found, not just the first. Use only after determining the spec is invalid or self-contradictory — not for recoverable uncertainty.

errors.description: All build errors found in the spec

reason.description: Why this part of the spec cannot be translated into correct code

spec_location.description: Which part of the spec is at fault, e.g. a proto name or section. Empty string if the error cannot be pinned to one location.
